title: Structure
intro: Each clause sits under the one that contains it, with its connector and its relation: that comes from the text and fixed rules. What is marked «Assistant» is its reading.
unavailable: The structure of this verse is not available.
noClauses: This verse has no words in the syntactic data.
frontedNote: It may be focus or frame; context decides.
attribution: Syntactic structure: MACULA {{lang}} (Clear Bible, CC BY 4.0).
legend: Under each word, its function: S subject · V verb · O object · IO indirect object · Adv adverbial · PP prepositional complement · Pred predicate · Cop copula.

notes.development: δέ marks a new step in the argument.
notes.purposeOrResult: ἵνα can express purpose or result; context decides.
notes.groundOrContent: It can be a ground («because») or content («that»); context decides.
notes.chain: The wayyiqtol moves the narrative forward.
notes.conjunctive: The waw joins a verb: it continues the previous line.
notes.disjunctive: The waw stands before something that is not a verb and breaks the chain: contrast, circumstance or change of topic.
notes.asyndetic: No conjunction: the link with what precedes is implicit.
notes.question: Interrogative εἰ: «whether…», not a condition.

classNotes.1: εἰ + indicative: presents the condition as true for the sake of the argument, not necessarily in fact.
classNotes.2: εἰ + past indicative, with ἄν in the apodosis: contrary to fact.
classNotes.3: ἐάν + subjunctive: a possible condition, yet to be seen.

legendIndent: Indentation shows which clause depends on which.
cardFronted: Placed before the verb as {{role}}: it may mark focus (emphasis) or frame (the topic); context decides.
readingTagTitle: The assistant's reading: it interprets the structure, which comes from the text.
resolvedNote: The text leaves «{{open}}» open; the assistant reads it as {{choice}}.
cardFrontedChosen: Placed before the verb as {{role}}: {{fronting}}, according to the assistant.

readingMissing.generate: Generate the analysis to see the reading of each clause.
readingMissing.stale: This analysis was generated before the clause reading. Re-analyze the verse to see it.
readingMissing.empty: The assistant did not return the clause reading in this analysis. Re-analyze the verse to request it.
